features.syntax_source: no doc/testfile syntax; doTempo regex only matches d/dd=number or bare number
features.evidence: 0 <metronome-relation>, 0 second beat-unit; the attempt is SILENTLY mis-parsed: regex takes '3' of '3/8' as per-minute, emitting quarter=3 and <sound tempo='3.00'> (playback near-frozen, no warning)
features.proposal: extend doTempo: when the right side of '=' is itself n/m (Q:1/4=3/8), emit <metronome> with beat-unit + optional dots on BOTH sides and no per-minute (MusicXML beat-unit,beat-unit pair), carry previous <sound tempo> forward unchanged; at minimum, warn instead of emitting tempo=3
